summary.name: Tungsten Edge
summary.one_liner: Tungsten Edge is a per-window taskbar and Dock replacement for macOS that shows every open window as its own labeled card.
use_cases: Switching between many open windows on a Mac
Replacing the macOS Dock with a taskbar
Seeing every open window at once
Pinning apps and folders to a taskbar
Keeping windows in place while switching
summary.what_it_does: Tungsten Edge places a taskbar on macOS where every open window gets its own labeled card, while single-window apps appear as compact icons. The page describes precise window switching, with windows staying where they are. It includes an app drawer and folder popups that close on an outside click, and pinned folders. Recent changes mentioned include drag-to-Trash for moving apps and ejecting disks, and a Diagnostics tab in Settings that copies a report for bug reports. The page says it is open source and lists a GitHub repository.
notable: Per-window labeled cards for every open window, with single-window apps as compact icons
Open source, with source on GitHub
Licence is tied to the user and survives new Macs and clean installs
caveats: US$24 one-time for version 1.0; currently free during the beta
Some listings describe it as freeware, but the page itself states a paid price for 1.0
